question: Which bill led to people staging a widespread protest in Delhi, Haryana, and Punjab in September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Farmers Bill.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Farmers Bill,** also known as the Farm Bills, were three bills passed by the** Indian Parliament in September 2020.**
 
• These bills aimed to reform the **agricultural sector of India **by providing freedom to farmers to sell their produce outside the **Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) mandis.**
 
• The Farmers Bill led to widespread protests in **Delhi, Haryana, and Punjab**, as the farmers believed that the bills would lead to the** dismantling of the APMC mandis,** which would result in them not getting the **Minimum Support Price (MSP) **for their crops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2021**, was introduced in the Lok Sabha in March 2021.
 
• **Energy Conservation (Amendment) Bill, 2020,** was introduced in the Lok Sabha in March 2020.
 
• **Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Bill, 2019,** was passed by the Indian Parliament in November 2019.
